    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    Action
    Action emitted by a machine, identified by machine id and event name.

    Annotation widget for editing a list of actions.

    Serializable list of actions associated with a transition.

    Base draggable annotation component bound to a piece of model content.

    Represents a PWS assembly and its state machines, guards, actions, and formulas.
    AssemblyGenerator
    Utility class that generates all possible Assembly instances by assigning to each state machine in the assembly one of its possible states as its current state.
    AssemblyGenerator
    Utility class that generates all possible Assembly instances by assigning to each state machine in the assembly one of its possible states as its current state.
    AssemblyInterface
    Defines the core API for assemblies and their analysis.

    Dialog for editing a machine instance within an assembly.

    Panel for viewing and editing an assembly's machines.

    Utility class that maps the current state of each state machine in an Assembly to a truth table vector representation.

    Rappresenta una proposizione di stato elementare del tipo "machineId.stateName".

    Binary serializer for saving and loading editor models.
